showcase.title: Two-Way PDF & Image Studio
showcase.subtitle: Merge photos into clean, multi-page PDFs or extract high-resolution raster images from PDF pages — all locally in your browser with zero upload.
tips: Drag and drop thumbnails to reorder pages before compiling into a PDF.
Choose Paper Size (A4, A3, Letter) in the sidebar for standardized document layouts.
Select 300 DPI when extracting images from PDF for crisp printing quality.
All conversions happen client-side — your confidential documents never leave your computer.

faqs.question: Can I combine different image formats into one PDF?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can mix JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and other formats into a single unified PDF document.

faqs.question: Are my documents uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Everything runs 100% locally inside your web browser using WebAssembly and canvas technologies for ultimate privacy.

faqs.question: What DPI should I choose when converting PDF to images?
faqs.answer: For web sharing, 72 or 150 DPI is fast and compact. For high-resolution archival or print, 300 DPI delivers maximum clarity.
